source_findings: The LSP 1.2.14 module manifest selects para-equalizer 1.0.21 and dsp-units 1.0.19.
Gain, frequency, or quality changes with stable filter type/slope enable bSmoothMode.
In smooth mode, process_channel loops over every audio sample and all filter slots, interpolates parameters with logf/expf, and calls Equalizer::process with samples=1.
Equalizer::set_params marks the bank for rebuilding when parameters differ. Equalizer::process calls reconfigure, which rebuilds every filter when the bank is dirty.
Filter::rebuild performs coefficient calculations, including the RLC path and trigonometric functions.
This explains why a single moving band can cause full-bank work. It identifies an expensive isolated path, not a complete explanation of live PipeWire deadline failures.
limitations: The profiler covers initialization, calibration, warmup, measurement, cleanup, and worker threads; it is not scenario-attributed.
